name: zcode-wakatime
description: Track ZCode usage time in WakaTime: sends heartbeats on UserPromptSubmit and PostToolUse via wakatime-cli, attributed to the current working directory's project.

description_i18n.en: Track ZCode usage time in WakaTime: sends heartbeats on UserPromptSubmit and PostToolUse via wakatime-cli, attributed to the current working directory's project.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把 ZCode 的使用时长计入 WakaTime：在提交提示词与工具调用后自动发心跳，按工作目录归属项目。ZCode 没有官方 WakaTime 插件，本插件补上这块。
